senses.gloss: (perh. מַעֲנֶה m.) handle of the plough; coulter.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:20">Tosef. Shebi. III, 20</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יסמוך לה מ׳</he>; Y. ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>ובלבד שלא יסמוך את המ׳</he> provided that (in training the cow for ploughing) he will not press the coulter (so as to make the appearance of real ploughing).
